answer: Lock every reward in escrow until a challenge window closes, so payment follows proof. While it sits locked, peers re-check the work and compare identities, and one confirmed fake burns the escrow of every linked identity. An attacker with a hundred sock puppets must fund a hundred escrows and keep them all clean for the window, while one slip wipes out the whole haul in one pass, like a comet shedding its tail. Honest agents feel a short delay, since their record stays crystal clear and a public beacon lists the identities that survived.
